title: How to use Psychology in a war zone – Ukraine - Trauma

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们除了用时间换取金钱之外还能赚取其他收益，会怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家玛丽安·特伦特博士，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动收入和循环收入来源。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一些令人兴奋的好消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many program is now open for enrollment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特的“一对多”项目现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，例如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己于2022年完成了该项目，此后也一直支持两批心理学家走过他们的成长历程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的专属联盟链接加入，你将获得苏菲的额外福利以及我提供的专属支持套餐，且无需支付任何额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四次小组智囊团指导、大师班、个性化指导、一份福特南·梅森的美食礼品以及限时的一对一教练指导福利。

sentences.en: Enrollment closes on Monday, the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名截止时间为11月16日（星期一）晚上10点。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 请通过简介中链接的我的福利页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的福利。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。

sentences.en: Coming up in today's episode, I am joined by Dr. Alastair Teeger, who returns to the podcast
sentences.zh: 在今天的节目中，我邀请到了阿拉斯泰尔·蒂格尔博士，他再次做客本播客节目

sentences.en: this time to talk with us about his experiences of helping set up a new service in Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 这一次，他将与我们分享他协助在乌克兰建立新服务的经历。

sentences.en: It is a fascinating listen.
sentences.zh: 这是一期非常引人入胜的节目。

sentences.en: We talk through all kinds of things and I hope you'll find it so useful.
sentences.zh: 我们探讨了各种各样的话题，希望你会觉得它非常有用。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along to the Aspiring Psychologist podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎收听“有抱负的心理学家”播客。

sentences.en: I am Dr. Marianne Trent and I'm a qualified clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士，我是一名合格的临床心理学家。

sentences.en: I've said it before and I will likely say it again.
sentences.zh: 我以前说过，而且我可能还会再说过。

sentences.en: I just love how varied our career in psychology and mental health can be.
sentences.zh: 我太喜欢我们在心理学和心理健康领域的职业生涯可以有多么丰富多彩了。

sentences.en: I love that the last time we met my guest for today, who is Dr. Alastair Teeger, we were talking about how to get an assistant psychologist job.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢上一次我们与今天的嘉宾阿拉斯泰尔·蒂格尔博士见面时，我们讨论的是如何找到助理心理学家的工作。

sentences.en: And in case you're wondering, that is episode 52.
sentences.zh: 如果你想知道的话，那是第52期节目。

sentences.en: So you can watch that on YouTube or take a listen via Spotify or Apple Podcasts.
sentences.zh: 因此你可以在YouTube上观看，或者通过Spotify或Apple Podcasts收听。

sentences.en: And, you know, that was a really well-received episode.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，那是一期广受好评的节目。

sentences.en: And today we are talking about the fact that shortly after we recorded that episode, he went off to Ukraine and has been there a few different times to help set up a service.
sentences.zh: 今天我们要讨论的是，就在我们录制完那期节目不久后，他便前往了乌克兰，并曾数次去那里协助建立服务。

sentences.en: I really wanted to talk with him to kind of get the download on what it had been like.
sentences.zh: 我真的很想跟他聊聊，以了解那里的真实情况。

sentences.en: And, you know, to help us think about how we can use our skills to benefit others in perhaps
sentences.zh: 并且，你知道的，帮助我们思考如何利用我们的技能去造福他人，也许是在

sentences.en: very different contexts than that which we learned them in or which we're familiar with ourselves.
sentences.zh: 与我们学习这些技能时或我们自己熟悉的环境截然不同的环境中。

sentences.en: Honestly, just a privilege to talk to him.
sentences.zh: 老实说，能与他交谈简直是一种荣幸。

sentences.en: I hope that you all gain a lot from it.
sentences.zh: 希望大家都能从中收获良多。

sentences.en: We do mention a concept called moral injury.
sentences.zh: 我们在节目中提到了一个叫做“道德损伤”的概念。

sentences.en: And I thought it might just be useful for me to explain what that is in case you don't know already.
sentences.zh: 我想我最好解释一下这是什么意思，以防你还不太了解。

sentences.en: So this was a term that I only really became aware of during the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 这个术语是我在疫情期间才真正开始了解到的。

sentences.en: And it was something that was cropping up for people, health staff, for example, who were having to make decisions over who to treat, who to give certain technology to if there's
sentences.zh: 这是当时人们（例如医护人员）经常遇到的一种情况，他们不得不做出艰难的决定：救治谁，或者在数量有限的情况下

sentences.en: only certain amounts available.
sentences.zh: 把某些医疗设备分配给谁。

sentences.en: And then afterwards, having to then deal with the consequences of those decisions of that moral decision.
sentences.zh: 而在事后，他们又不得不去应对这些决定、这些道德抉择所带来的后果。

sentences.en: And you kind of can have a trauma presentation.
sentences.zh: 你可能会因此表现出类似创伤的症状。

sentences.en: So that's what moral injury is.
sentences.zh: 所以，这就是道德损伤。

sentences.en: So, yeah, just to save you a Google, because I like this to be a one stop shop for useful stuff for you.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，这就省得你去谷歌搜索了，因为我希望这里能成为你获取实用信息的一站式平台。

sentences.en: If you've got any ideas for future podcast episodes, please do get in contact with me and let me know.
sentences.zh: 如果你对未来的播客节目有任何想法，请务必与我联系并告诉我。

sentences.en: Please also, if you do value this content, please do rate and review it both on Spotify and or
sentences.zh: 另外，如果你确实觉得这些内容很有价值，请务必在Spotify和/或

sentences.en: Apple podcasts.
sentences.zh: Apple Podcasts上给予评分和评论。

sentences.en: And if you're watching this on YouTube, please do like, subscribe, share the content to help
sentences.zh: 如果你正在YouTube上观看本视频，请务必点赞、订阅、分享内容，以帮助

sentences.en: us get this word of the podcast that is getting really lovely feedback to as many people as possible.
sentences.zh: 我们把这个获得了非常美好反馈的播客节目传播给尽可能多的人。

sentences.en: Don't let me stop you.
sentences.zh: 别让我打扰你。

sentences.en: Let's dive in.
sentences.zh: 让我们深入正题吧。

sentences.en: Let's reconnect with Alistair.
sentences.zh: 让我们重新联系阿拉斯泰尔。

sentences.en: And I will see you on the other side of this.
sentences.zh: 节目过后再见。

sentences.en: Just want to welcome our guests back to the podcast today because we met Dr. Alistair previously
sentences.zh: 今天我想再次欢迎我们的嘉宾回到播客节目中，因为我们之前见过阿拉斯泰尔博士

sentences.en: when we were talking about how to get assistant psychologist jobs, but we were also discussing
sentences.zh: 当时我们正在讨论如何获得助理心理学家的工作，但我们也讨论了

sentences.en: the very exciting and potentially a little bit worrying trip that you were about to make,
sentences.zh: 那趟令人兴奋、可能也让人有点担忧的旅程，阿拉斯泰尔，也就是你要去的

sentences.en: Alistair, which was to go to Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰之行。

sentences.en: Welcome back.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回来。

sentences.en: Thank you for being here.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你来到这里。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我。

sentences.en: Much appreciated.
sentences.zh: 非常感激。

sentences.en: So can you tell us a little bit about what your experiences were like when you went to
sentences.zh: 那么，你能跟我们讲讲你去乌克兰时的经历是怎样的吗？

sentences.en: Ukraine?
sentences.zh: 乌克兰？

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, of course.
sentences.zh: 可以，当然可以。

sentences.en: What helped us, I suppose, give a bit of the background to how it came about.
sentences.zh: 我想，可以先介绍一下这件事是如何促成的背景。

sentences.en: Sure, that would be great.
sentences.zh: 当然，那太好了。

sentences.en: I don't think it's something I thought I was going to be doing as an aspiring clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这并不是我作为一个有志成为临床心理学家的人会去做的事。

sentences.en: So yeah, coming out of training, I worked in neuropsychology.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，结束培训后，我在神经心理学领域工作过。

sentences.en: I also worked in major trauma center.
sentences.zh: 我还曾在重大创伤中心工作过。

sentences.en: So with people with brain injuries, spinal injuries, musculoskeletal injuries.
sentences.zh: 服务对象包括脑损伤、脊髓损伤、肌肉骨骼损伤的患者。

sentences.en: And I suppose as a part of that, when I was working or overseeing the major trauma service, the Ariana Grande concert bombing happened, so the Manchester Arena attack.
sentences.zh: 我想作为其中的一部分，当我在工作或监督重大创伤服务时，爱莉安娜·格兰德演唱会爆炸案发生了，也就是曼彻斯特体育场袭击事件。

sentences.en: And we're based at Salford.
sentences.zh: 我们的基地在索尔福德。

sentences.en: So we had a number of people come to our hospital as part of the major incident.
sentences.zh: 因此，作为这一突发事件的一部分，有许多人来到了我们的医院。

sentences.en: So we provided a lot of the acute psychosocial care.
sentences.zh: 我们提供了大量的急性心理社会照护。

sentences.en: And then more recently, we've sort of developed a bit of spinal cord injury service as well.
sentences.zh: 最近，我们还建立了一些脊髓损伤服务。

sentences.en: So I suppose, thinking about Ukraine and what's going on there in the war, and sort of some of my areas of expertise, I think the World Health Organization reached out to a number
sentences.zh: 所以我想，考虑到乌克兰以及那里正在发生的战争，还有我的一些专业领域，世界卫生组织似乎联系了许多

sentences.en: of services, including the Stoke Mandeville, which is the National Spinal Cord Injury Center.
sentences.zh: 服务机构，包括斯托克曼德维尔医院，即国家脊髓损伤中心。

sentences.en: And I've been in a couple of networks with guys from there.
sentences.zh: 我曾与那里的人们在几个网络中合作过。

sentences.en: And Dr. Jane Duff, who's the lead there, she kind of knew my background and thought, actually, this is probably up your street or within your wheelhouse.
sentences.zh: 那里的负责人简·达夫博士了解我的背景，她认为实际上这可能很符合你的专长或在你的能力范围内。

sentences.en: So yeah, they were trying to set up a National Rehabilitation Center for casualties of the
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，他们当时正试图为战争中的伤员（平民和军人）建立一个国家康复中心

sentences.en: war, civilians and military, with an onus on spinal cord injury and traumatic brain injury.
sentences.zh: 重点关注脊髓损伤和创伤性脑损伤。

sentences.en: So I suppose that's where I thought, actually, that's probably something I can offer.
sentences.zh: 所以我想这就是我当时的想法：这可能是我能够提供帮助的事情。

sentences.en: I wanted to be able to do something, but wasn't sure what that was.
sentences.zh: 我想做点什么，但不确定具体该做什么。

sentences.en: And then this landed in my email inbox.
sentences.zh: 然后这个消息就落入了我的收件箱。

sentences.en: And I thought, you know, I'm going to follow that up, really.
sentences.zh: 我想，你知道的，我真的要跟进这件事。

sentences.en: So yeah, I suppose that's a bit of the backdrop to it.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我想这就是事情的背景。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah, like, it's an incredible career that we're in, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 是的，我们从事的职业真是不可思议，不是吗？

sentences.en: That sometimes something will just drop into your emails that you weren't necessarily pursuing.
sentences.zh: 有时一些你原本并未刻意追求的事情就会突然出现在你的电子邮件里。

sentences.en: But once you know about it, you're like, oh, that is intriguing.
sentences.zh: 但一旦你了解了它，你就会想：“哦，这真引人入胜。”

sentences.en: I think I would like that.
sentences.zh: “我想我会喜欢这个。”

sentences.en: I think I would do that well.
sentences.zh: “我想我能把它做好。”

sentences.en: And it's that flexibility of our skills, but also our eagerness to learn and to support and, you know, help people as well, I think.
sentences.zh: 我认为，这正是我们技能的灵活性，以及我们的求知欲、支持意愿和帮助他人的精神的体现。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, I think I've never been particularly ambitious to want to do one thing or the other.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，我从来没有对做这样或那样的事情抱有特别大的野心。

sentences.en: But I've been sometimes in the right place at the right time and perhaps a bit opportunistic.
sentences.zh: 但我有时会在正确的时间出现在正确的地点，也许还有点机会主义。

sentences.en: And obviously, with it being that the war in Ukraine, people were incredibly supportive from my hospital, Northern Care Alliance.
sentences.zh: 而且显然，鉴于那是乌克兰战争，我的医院（北方医疗保健联盟）给予了极大的支持。

sentences.en: They wanted to be able to support the effort in some way.
sentences.zh: 他们希望能够以某种方式支持这项工作。

sentences.en: So they were able to, you know, provide me with the leave, but also permission to explore it, really.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们不仅批准了我的假期，还允许我去探索这种可能性。

sentences.en: So yeah, just went from there, really.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，一切就从那里开始了。

sentences.en: Great.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: And how long were you there for?
sentences.zh: 你在那里待了多久？

sentences.en: So I worked there off and on between start of December and end of March.
sentences.zh: 我在12月初到3月底之间断断续续地在那里工作。

sentences.en: But I was effectively doing about two weeks in Ukraine and then coming back, working in
sentences.zh: 但实际上我基本上是在乌克兰待两周，然后回来

sentences.en: NHS for two weeks, then going back to Ukraine for two weeks.
sentences.zh: 在国民医疗服务体系（NHS）工作两周，接着再回乌克兰待两周。

sentences.en: But it's quite difficult because I suppose contextually, you know, it is a war zone.
sentences.zh: 但这相当困难，因为从背景上讲，你知道的，那是一个战区。

sentences.en: So it would take me two or three days to get to the hospital where we're working.
sentences.zh: 因此，我需要两到三天才能到达我们工作的医院。

sentences.en: And that's because I have to fly into Poland.
sentences.zh: 这是因为我必须飞往波兰。

sentences.en: Well, for starters, I'd have to get from Chester to Stansted, which is where most of the flights go to a place called Zhezhov in Poland.
sentences.zh: 好吧，首先，我得从切斯特赶到斯坦斯特德，飞往波兰热舒夫的航班大都从那里起飞。

sentences.en: Then I'd stay there overnight.
sentences.zh: 然后我在那里过夜。

sentences.en: Then I'd have to get a UN vehicle across the border to Lviv.
sentences.zh: 接着我必须乘坐联合国车辆过境前往利沃夫。

sentences.en: And then I'd stay over there overnight because you're not allowed to travel in UN vehicles during nighttime.
sentences.zh: 然后我在那里过夜，因为夜间不允许乘坐联合国车辆出行。

sentences.en: And then you've got to line up with them when the transports happen.
sentences.zh: 之后你必须配合他们的运输时间安排列队出发。

sentences.en: So then the next day I'd get a lift up to where we were based.
sentences.zh: 所以在第二天，我搭车前往我们的驻地。

sentences.en: So it's quite disjointed, but also understandably so.
sentences.zh: 所以这相当零散，但也完全可以理解。

sentences.en: So if I was out there for 14 to 16 days, I might only be in the hospital for eight days because of the travel restrictions, really.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果我在那里待14到16天，由于旅行限制，我实际在医院里的时间可能只有8天。

sentences.en: And I think personally, I went out for a week in December to start just to get a feel for
sentences.zh: 而且我认为就我个人而言，我在12月份去了那儿一周，先去感受一下

sentences.en: it, which was really useful because it's quite anxiety provoking to think about where I was going, possibly more for my mum, less than my dad, when they heard what I was going to
sentences.zh: 这非常有用，因为去我要去的地方会让人产生相当大的焦虑感，对于我妈妈来说可能更是如此，对我爸爸而言稍微少一点，当他们听到我要去

sentences.en: be doing.
sentences.zh: 做的事情时。

sentences.en: So I think it provided them with a bit of a reassurance.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这给他们提供了一点安心。

sentences.en: And also it's kind of a dry run for me, you know, sort of get to know the country a bit, get to know what the needs were.
sentences.zh: 这也算是我的一次实地演练，你知道的，去了解一下这个国家，了解一下那里的需求是什么。

sentences.en: In the first week of January to sort of, I suppose, start the work in earneSt.
sentences.zh: 然后在1月的第一周，开始认真开展工作。

sentences.en: So, yeah, that's that side of things.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，就是那方面的情况。

sentences.en: It was, it's a beautiful country.
sentences.zh: 那是一个美丽的国家。

sentences.en: I've loved being out there, like experiencing the culture and stuff, but it's also incredibly daunting and humbling to see what they're going through and what we can come back to.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢去那里，去体验那里的文化之类的，但看到他们正在经历的一切以及我们能回到怎样的环境中，也让人感到无比气馁和谦卑。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah, I feel like I've learned a tiny amount of culture from some Ukrainian refugees my mum had staying with her for a while and seeing their pictures of, you know, their homes and
sentences.zh: 是的，我觉得我从我妈妈接待过一段时间的一些乌克兰难民那里了解了一点点文化，看到他们展示的关于他们的家以及

sentences.en: their areas where they'd lived before.
sentences.zh: 他们以前生活过的地方的照片。

sentences.en: It was beautiful.
sentences.zh: 那真的很美。

sentences.en: And then seeing, you know, what it had been raised to.
sentences.zh: 然后看到那些地方变成了什么样。

sentences.en: It was, you know, just tragic.
sentences.zh: 真的是，太悲惨了。

sentences.en: And it's real people, you know, it's really, really emotive, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 而且那是活生生的人，你知道的，这真的、真的很触动人心，不是吗？

sentences.en: And we're recording this, Alistair, as you know, in the time when actually there's lots and lots in the media about the Israel attacks and the atrocities that have been happening
sentences.zh: 正如你所知，阿拉斯泰尔，我们录制这期节目的时候，媒体上有很多关于以色列袭击事件以及那里一直在发生的暴行的报道

sentences.en: there.
sentences.zh: 那里的。

sentences.en: And I was in a private practice discussion for someone who was a clinical psychologist
sentences.zh: 当时我正在参加一个私人诊所的讨论，对象是一位

sentences.en: that lives and works in Israel, but had trained in the UK and was really trying to help people, you know, in a crisis situation, but isn't necessarily a trauma therapiSt.
sentences.zh: 居住在以色列并工作的临床心理学家，但她曾在英国接受培训，并且真的在努力帮助人们（在危机情况下），但她不一定是一名创伤治疗师。

sentences.en: And was saying, how can I do this?
sentences.zh: 她当时说，我该怎么做？

sentences.en: How can I be help?
sentences.zh: 我怎样才能提供帮助？

sentences.en: How can I be help?
sentences.zh: 我怎样才能提供帮助？

sentences.en: And, you know, I also work in trauma.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，我也从事创伤工作。

sentences.en: And I was sort of saying, well, it's very difficult to try and help people find safety when there's so many unanswered questions and when we can't get that felt sense of safety.
sentences.zh: 我当时就说，嗯，当有这么多悬而未决的问题，当我们无法获得那种安全感时，试图帮助人们找到安全感是非常困难的。

sentences.en: And, of course, when we're doing trauma work, it's partly we're having to say to people, it's over now, you know?
sentences.zh: 当然，当我们做创伤工作时，部分原因是我们不得不对人们说：一切都结束了，你知道吗？

sentences.en: How do you do that?
sentences.zh: 你如何做到这一点？

sentences.en: How do you manage that when you're in an ongoing situation?
sentences.zh: 当你身处持续不断的环境中时，你如何应对这一点？

sentences.en: Yeah, million dollar question, really.
sentences.zh: 是的，这真是一个价值百万美元的问题。

sentences.en: I think one of the things I've talked about in a few of the conferences we've been to or with colleagues is actually there's a collective trauma going on.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们在参加过的一些会议上或与同事交流时谈到的一点是，实际上那里正在发生集体创伤。

sentences.en: You know, the psychologist that we're working with.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，与我们合作的心理学家。

sentences.en: So the role was more around training up the psychologist, getting a sense of what they're working with and perhaps identifying needs.
sentences.zh: 所以这个角色的更多职责在于培训心理学家，了解他们的工作内容，并可能识别需求。

sentences.en: But they're going through trauma.
sentences.zh: 但他们正在经历创伤。

sentences.en: They're, you know, they're listening to the radio, watching the news every day.
sentences.zh: 他们，你知道的，每天都在听广播、看新闻。

sentences.en: There's a lot of people that they know have been hurt, killed or friends of friends, et cetera.
sentences.zh: 有很多人是他们认识的、受伤的、遇难的，或者是朋友的朋友等等。

sentences.en: So it's all very close to home.
sentences.zh: 所以这一切都离他们的生活非常近。

sentences.en: So them trying to manage their own well-being, for want of a better word, is really tricky.
sentences.zh: 因此，试图照顾好他们自己的福祉（如果可以用这个词的话）真的是一件非常棘手的事情。

sentences.en: I think because there was, I suppose, a spinal cord injury or SCI centre and a traumatic brain injury centre as well,
sentences.zh: 我认为，由于存在脊髓损伤（SCI）中心和创伤性脑损伤中心，

sentences.en: there was certainly a degree of trying to get the patients or the clients through rehabilitation
sentences.zh: 确实在很大程度上试图让患者或客户通过康复训练

sentences.en: or get them engaged in rehabilitation to minimise their difficulties further down the line.
sentences.zh: 或者让他们参与康复训练，以尽量减少他们日后遇到的困难。

sentences.en: But there's lots of other things coming up, you know, lots of guys with PTSD, lots of anxiety, lots of low mood, lots of maladaptive coping strategies.
sentences.zh: 不过还有很多其他问题会出现，你知道的，很多患有创伤后应激障碍的人，很多焦虑，很多情绪低落，还有很多适应不良的应对策略。

sentences.en: So almost trying to unpick that as well and trying to navigate it.
sentences.zh: 所以几乎也是在试图理清这些问题，并学着去应对它们。

sentences.en: And then also displacement.
sentences.zh: 然后还有流离失所的问题。

sentences.en: So millions of people have had to move and millions of people can't go back to where they are from.
sentences.zh: 数以百万计的人不得不背井离乡，数以百万计的人无法返回家园。

sentences.en: So even just trying to get these guys back or discharged from the hospital is a real tricky thing.
sentences.zh: 所以，光是尝试让这些人重返社会或让他们从医院出院，就是一件非常棘手的事情。

sentences.en: I've been really impressed, though, with, you know, for saying in Ukraine, there's not a formal pathway for psychologists.
sentences.zh: 不过，我对乌克兰的印象真的很深刻，因为如你所知，在乌克兰，心理学家并没有一个正式的职业路径。

sentences.en: A lot of the stuff they're doing is similar to what we do, but perhaps not necessarily with our clinical training or evidence base or sort of theory practice links.
sentences.zh: 他们做很多事情跟我们做得很相似，但可能不一定具备我们的临床培训、证据基础，或者说理论与实践的结合。

sentences.en: But it does make sense.
sentences.zh: 但这也确实说得通。

sentences.en: So I think for me is trying to provide them or help them think about core skills.
sentences.zh: 所以对我和我而言，我认为就是努力向他们提供核心技能，或者帮助他们思考核心技能。

sentences.en: So there's things like motivational interviewing techniques and even just goal setting.
sentences.zh: 这里面包括一些东西，比如动机访谈技术，甚至仅仅是设定目标。

sentences.en: Also thinking about adjustment after spinal injury.
sentences.zh: 同时也要考虑脊髓损伤后的心理适应。

sentences.en: But with me only being out there effectively two or three months, I was never going to be able to train them in a therapeutic orientation.
sentences.zh: 但由于我实际上只在那里待了两到三个月，我从来没打算以某种治疗导向去培训他们。

sentences.en: So we were trying to recommend that the WHO and the Ukrainian Ministry of Health look at getting them formal or accredited qualifications
sentences.zh: 所以我们试图建议世界卫生组织和乌克兰卫生部，考虑为他们提供正式的或获得认证的资格证书

sentences.en: in things like CBT and in EMDR, because it's a recognition to the fact that those things would be helpful for a variety of reasons for the patients they were working with.
sentences.zh: 比如认知行为疗法（CBT）和眼动脱敏再加工疗法（EMDR）领域的资质，因为大家认识到，由于种种原因，这些疗法对他们正在服务的患者会非常有帮助。

sentences.en: So, yeah, really multifactorial.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，真的是多重因素交织在一起。

sentences.en: And like I say, it's difficult to concentrate on one thing when there's a backdrop of systemic problems that you're not going to be able to resolve.
sentences.zh: 正如我所说，当你面对一系列无法解决的系统性问题时，很难把注意力集中在单一事情上。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全同意。

sentences.en: And I guess it's knowing that what you're doing is all that can be done right now and that it's helpful and worthwhile.
sentences.zh: 我想这也是因为你明白，你现在所做的一切已经是力所能及的全部了，而且它是切实有用且有价值的。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's something I've reflected on a fair bit, because, again,
sentences.zh: 是的，这也是我反复思考过的一点，因为同样地，

sentences.en: I knew I was doing a relatively short term contract and I knew I wouldn't be able to do everything that would be possible, sort of moral injury side of things.
sentences.zh: 我知道自己签的是一个相对短期的合同，我也清楚自己无法完成所有可能要做的事情，比如道德损伤那方面的事。

sentences.en: But I suppose being in amongst that system, that ecosystem, you get more of an idea of what the government are doing or how the people are seeing things.
sentences.zh: 但我想，身处那个体制、那个生态系统之中，你会对政府在做什么，或者人们是如何看待事物的，有更多的了解。

sentences.en: So Zelensky's wife is the first lady and she's very much on the mental health ticket.
sentences.zh: 所以泽连斯基的妻子是第一夫人，她非常关注心理健康这个议题。

sentences.en: She's really promoting that stuff for civilians, for the military, but also those providing care.
sentences.zh: 她大力向平民、军人以及那些提供护理服务的人推广这些内容。

sentences.en: And I think from talking to the psychologists in Ukraine as well, mental health is taboo.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，从与乌克兰当地心理学家的交谈中也发现，心理健康是个禁忌话题。

sentences.en: It is in most places, but they feel it's very much so out there, a very proud country.
sentences.zh: 虽然在大多数地方都是如此，但他们觉得在那里尤其明显，那是一个非常骄傲的国家。

sentences.en: But I think this is bringing it to the surface and I think it might be changing the culture in some ways in trying to say that it doesn't can happen to people.
sentences.zh: 但我认为这正在把问题浮出水面，我觉得它在某种程度上可能会改变文化，试图表明这种事是会发生在任何人身上的。

sentences.en: And we need to think about how we support people before, during and after in order to try and help people get better.
sentences.zh: 我们需要考虑如何在事发前、事发中以及事后支持人们，以此来帮助人们康复。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全同意。

sentences.en: And, you know, to be human is to, you know, actually absolutely be unifying.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，身为人类，实际上绝对是具有凝聚力的。

sentences.en: But it sounds like actually it's just it's culture and kind of traditions that dictate how mental health is responded to.
sentences.zh: 但听上去，实际上正是文化和各种传统决定了人们如何应对心理健康问题。

sentences.en: But actually, the symptoms of mental health are pretty, pretty consistent across our human population.
sentences.zh: 然而事实上，心理健康的症状在我们整个人类群体中是相当相当一致的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想是的。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think you're right there.
sentences.zh: 对，我想你说得对。

sentences.en: I think there's definitely cultural language difficulties or differences, but there's often commonalities that we can see between people as well.
sentences.zh: 我认为文化语言上肯定存在困难或差异，但我们在不同人群之间往往也能看到许多共同点。

sentences.en: I'm intrigued in your opinion.
sentences.zh: 我对你的看法很感兴趣。

sentences.en: So today I've been on LBC radio because a very big newspaper in the UK had decided to print a really emotive photo.
sentences.zh: 所以今天我上了LBC广播电台，因为英国一家非常大的报纸决定刊登一张极具情感冲击力的照片。

sentences.en: I won't share too much information about it in case it's triggering for people.
sentences.zh: 我不会透露太多细节，以防给某些人带来心理创触发。

sentences.en: But the question I was asked is, was it right to print that?
sentences.zh: 但我被问到的问题是：刊登这张照片对吗？

sentences.en: Is there a responsibility to print that?
sentences.zh: 我们有责任刊登它吗？

sentences.en: And they were really pushing me on that.
sentences.zh: 他们当时一直在拿这个问题逼问我。

sentences.en: And I was sort of dancing around that topic because, you know, in essence, my answer is maybe not in Baby Loss Awareness Week.
sentences.zh: 我当时有点在那个话题边缘打太极，因为，说实话，我的回答是：也许在流产关怀周（Baby Loss Awareness Week）期间不应该这么做。

sentences.en: You know, there's better times we could do that.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们可以挑更好的时间来做这件事。

sentences.en: But it's so triggering to people, this kind of emotive photography.
sentences.zh: 但这种充满情感冲击力的摄影作品对人们来说太容易造成心理创触发了。

sentences.en: What's your viewpoint on that, Alistair?
sentences.zh: 阿利斯泰尔，你对这件事怎么看？

sentences.en: So obviously I'm not an expert in it,
sentences.zh: 显然我不是这方面的专家，

sentences.en: but I did go to a talk at the European Congress of Psychology in Brighton over the summer and they had an expert from the US on this very topic.
sentences.zh: 但在今年夏天，我去了布莱顿参加欧洲心理学大会的一场讲座，会上请了一位来自美国的该领域专家。

sentences.en: And her advice was if there's new stories with images that are potentially traumatizing, then she covers them up.
sentences.zh: 她的建议是，如果新闻报道中配有潜在致创伤性的图片，她就会把它们遮盖掉。

sentences.en: She doesn't click on the videos.
sentences.zh: 她不会去点开那些视频。

sentences.en: She might read the text, but she's their evidence is that if you engage with the picture or the video,
sentences.zh: 她可能会阅读文字，但他们的证据表明，如果你去接触图片或视频，

sentences.en: you're more likely to get secondary traumatization than you were if you just to read the text.
sentences.zh: 你受到二次创伤的可能性，要比你只阅读文字时大得多。

sentences.en: So that's not my opinion.
sentences.zh: 所以这不是我个人的意见。

sentences.en: But I well, I get it.
sentences.zh: 不过，嗯，我懂。

sentences.en: I agree with it.
sentences.zh: 我赞同这一点。

sentences.en: And I'm trying to practice that a bit to myself.
sentences.zh: 我也正试着在自己身上践行这一点。

sentences.en: But that's where they sat with it.
sentences.zh: 不过，这就是他们的立场。

sentences.en: Yeah, I wouldn't like to comment on the moral duty of a newspaper because it's difficult because you've got.
sentences.zh: 是的，我对报纸的道德责任不予置评，因为这很艰难，因为你面临着。

sentences.en: Raising awareness of things that are going on versus how do you do that and what content do you put out there for others to see?
sentences.zh: 一方面要提高人们对正在发生的事情的认识，另一方面又该如何去做，以及你要发布什么样的内容供他人观看？

sentences.en: Yeah, I agree.
sentences.zh: 是的，我同意。

sentences.en: And in the pre-production chat that I'd had, I was saying, you know, this this does kind of make us aware of what humanity is capable of,
sentences.zh: 在我之前进行的制作前交流中，我曾说过，你知道，这确实让我们意识到人类能够做到什么地步，

sentences.en: you know, in terms of the compassionate, focused trauma, you know, approach, you know, humans are capable of doing really awful things on purpose to other people.
sentences.zh: 你知道，就同情聚焦的创伤方法而言，人类能够对其他人做出非常可怕的蓄意行径。

sentences.en: But also we're capable of imagining, you know, we don't necessarily need to see a photo to, you know, to have it paint a thousand words.
sentences.zh: 但同时我们也能够去想象，你知道，我们不一定非要看到一张照片，才能体会到胜过千言万语的感受。

sentences.en: And sometimes you don't need to see pictures of people that are wounded.
sentences.zh: 有时候你不需要看到受伤者的照片。

sentences.en: Sometimes just the setting where they've been wounded is equally as powerful.
sentences.zh: 有时候，仅仅是他们受伤的那个场景，就同样具有强大的冲击力。

sentences.en: You know, I'm still struck with the images of when Osama bin Laden was was killed.
sentences.zh: 你知道，奥萨马·本·拉登被击毙时的那些画面至今仍震撼着我。

sentences.en: That was really, really powerful.
sentences.zh: 那真的非常非常有冲击力。

sentences.en: You didn't see him, but you saw the room and that's, you know, it is powerful.
sentences.zh: 你没有看到他本人，但你看到了那个房间，你知道的，这确实很有力量。

sentences.en: And I guess when we're working with people who either are traumatized or have been traumatized,
sentences.zh: 我想当我们与那些正在经历创伤或曾遭受创伤的人共事时，

sentences.en: there's a real impact of vicarious trauma, both upon ourselves, but, you know, upon people that you have been working with as well.
sentences.zh: 替代性创伤会产生真正的重大影响，不仅对我们自己，而且，你知道的，也对你一直共事的人产生影响。

sentences.en: How do we look after ourselves in terms of vicarious trauma?
sentences.zh: 我们在应对替代性创伤时该如何照顾好自己呢？

sentences.en: How have you been looking after yourself?
sentences.zh: 你一直是怎样照顾自己的？

sentences.en: Yeah, I think before I went out, I was trying to make sure, trying to think about that before I needed to.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想在我出发之前，我就一直在努力确保这一点，在需要之前就开始思考这个问题。

sentences.en: And, you know, it's interesting.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，这很有趣。

sentences.en: The first when I went out in December, we're in a hotel that was slightly out of the city that we're based in.
sentences.zh: 当我12月第一次出发时，我们住在离我们驻地城市稍远的一家酒店里。

sentences.en: And, you know, we'd go to work in the morning, get back at four ish, but it was winter, it was cold, it was dark.
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道，我们早上上班，四点左右回来，但那是冬天，又冷又黑。

sentences.en: There's nothing else around, particularly.
sentences.zh: 周围基本上没什么别的。

sentences.en: You think about the things that we do around achievement, connection, I suppose, enjoyment.
sentences.zh: 你想想我们在成就感、人际连接以及快乐方面所做的事情。

sentences.en: You know, internet connectivity was poor, so it was difficult to speak to people back home or even just go on social media to connect with people or stream stuff.
sentences.zh: 你知道，网络信号很差，所以很难跟家里人通话，甚至很难仅仅通过社交媒体与人联系或看在线视频。

sentences.en: There wasn't a gym in the hotel, so you couldn't necessarily do anything to keep yourself active.
sentences.zh: 酒店里没有健身房，所以你没法做任何事情来保持活力。

sentences.en: You couldn't go out for a walk because we're on a dual carriageway.
sentences.zh: 你不能出去散步，因为我们住在双车道公路旁。

sentences.en: The nearest thing was like a supermarket half a mile away.
sentences.zh: 离得最近的东西大概是半英里外的一个超市。

sentences.en: And so I felt that the first time around.
sentences.zh: 所以第一次去的时候我确实有这种感受。

sentences.en: I thought, you know, I took out some gym gear to work out in the room, tried to think about eating healthily, but that's very difficult when you're living in a hotel.
sentences.zh: 我想，你知道，我带了一些健身装备在房间里锻炼，试着考虑健康饮食，但当你住在酒店时，这非常困难。

sentences.en: So I think as a, I suppose, as a WHO team, we sort of agreed that we'd move into the city for the January to March phase because for me, I wanted to be a part of it.
sentences.zh: 所以我想，作为世卫组织团队的一员，我们基本上一致同意在1月到3月的阶段搬到城里去，因为对我来说，我想成为其中的一部分。

sentences.en: And I like to go for a coffee or I like to go to the gym or I like to have a few options once I get back from work.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢去喝杯咖啡，或者我喜欢去健身房，或者我喜欢在下班后有一些选择。

sentences.en: And that was a really strong move to, I suppose, be closer to it and also be able to experience the Ukrainian culture a bit more.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常有力举措，我想是为了更贴近当地，也能够更多地体验乌克兰文化。

sentences.en: You know, I went to a coffee shop regularly in the morning and they got to know my order.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我早上经常去一家咖啡馆，他们都熟悉我要点什么了。

sentences.en: I joined a gym and went to that like several times a week.
sentences.zh: 我加入了一家健身房，一周去好几次。

sentences.en: And that was great for me because, you know, I usually go out mountain biking or swimming or going to the gym and stuff.
sentences.zh: 这对我来说太棒了，因为，你知道，我通常会去骑山地车、游泳或去健身房之类的地方。

sentences.en: There were lots of restaurants we could go to.
sentences.zh: 有很多餐厅我们可以去。

sentences.en: So again, sort of like dipping into that.
sentences.zh: 所以同样地，就像是去体验一下当地生活。

sentences.en: I think in addition to that, you've also got to think about what you eat.
sentences.zh: 我想除此之外，你还得考虑你吃什么。

sentences.en: So my routine when I've had to think about what I eat when I get back, because, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以我的日常就是当我回来后必须考虑我吃什么，因为，你知道，

sentences.en: I probably put about 10 pounds from just sort of living the life and eating in hotels or restaurants three times a day.
sentences.zh: 仅仅因为那种生活方式以及一天三顿在酒店或餐厅吃饭，我大概胖了10磅左右。

sentences.en: And then I suppose the other things is trying to think about, again, foundation stuff, but, you know, not drinking particularly.
sentences.zh: 然后我想其他的事情就是试着去思考，同样是基础的事情，但，你知道，基本上不怎么喝酒。

sentences.en: You know, I'm not a big drinker, but I'd have to make sure that I watched that because it's quite easy to when you're meeting new people
sentences.zh: 你知道，我不是个贪杯的人，但我必须确保注意这一点，因为当你遇到新面孔时，很容易做到这一点，

sentences.en: or you've got sort of meetings with officials, you have a drink called the tradition around it and sleep, sleeping somewhere different.
sentences.zh: 或者当你与官员开会时，你要喝上一杯或围绕它有一些传统，还有睡眠，在不同的地方睡觉。

sentences.en: I'm not going to lie.
sentences.zh: 我不会撒谎。

sentences.en: There were air raids or air raid sirens, you know, sort of every couple of days.
sentences.zh: 空袭或空袭警报，你知道的，大约每隔几天就会有一次。

sentences.en: And they could be any time of the day.
sentences.zh: 而且它们可能发生在一天中的任何时间。

sentences.en: They could be in the middle of the night.
sentences.zh: 它们可能发生在半夜。

sentences.en: They could be for 10 minutes.
sentences.zh: 可能持续10分钟。

sentences.en: It could be for three hours.
sentences.zh: 也可能持续三个小时。

sentences.en: So it's trying to think about, you know, I often sleep with earplugs and eye masks.
sentences.zh: 所以这让我试着去思考，你知道的，我睡觉时经常戴耳塞和眼罩。

sentences.en: They definitely came with me, had some herbal sleeping stuff that I took occasionally.
sentences.zh: 它们绝对是随身携带的，我还带了一些草药类的助眠产品，偶尔会吃一点。

sentences.en: But that was just to try and keep me going because it's easy to say, but you're in threat mode most of the time.
sentences.zh: 但这只是为了让我撑下去，因为说起来容易，但你大部分时间都处于威胁模式中。

sentences.en: And the work we were doing was pretty intense.
sentences.zh: 而且我们所做的工作相当高强度。

sentences.en: I was also trying to navigate doing stuff back here by either providing supervision or dipping in on more complex cases that I'd left behind.
sentences.zh: 我还得设法兼顾处理这里的事情，要么通过提供督导，要么参与介入我留下的那些更复杂的病例。

sentences.en: So it's almost like give yourself permission to say, actually, I'll dip out of this or I'd not go to that or I need to, I'm going to give myself permission to self-care a bit.
sentences.zh: 所以这就像是给自己一种允许，对自己说：其实，我可以不参与这个，或者我不去那个，我需要、我要允许自己稍微进行一点自我关怀。

sentences.en: It's all very well and good saying that, but it's very hard to do it.
sentences.zh: 说起来容易做起来难。

sentences.en: So I think for me, going out there and having that was really important.
sentences.zh: 所以我想对我来说，去到那里并拥有这一切真的非常重要。

sentences.en: And then when I came back, you know, it would probably take anything from a few days to maybe a week or so to just decompress.
sentences.zh: 然后当我回来的时候，你知道，大概需要几天到一周左右的时间来放松解压。

sentences.en: You know, I wasn't like up here, but I was a bit more down, you know, sort of the sort of the counter counter side to that.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我并没有处于亢奋状态，而是情绪有点低落，你知道，也就是那种相对的反向状态。

sentences.en: So, again, for me, it's trying to do stuff with my wife and my dog and meet mates or organize a night or a day where I'd go, actually,
sentences.zh: 所以，同样地，对我和我而言，就是努力和我的妻子、我的狗狗一起做些事情，去见见朋友，或者安排一个晚上或一天，对他们说：其实，

sentences.en: I'll put this in the diary because when I come back, I might not want to do that.
sentences.zh: 我要把这个记在日程表里，因为等我回来时，我可能就不想做这些了。

sentences.en: But if there's something already organized, it's kind of in the offing.
sentences.zh: 但如果已经安排好了某些事情，它就相当于在酝酿之中了。

sentences.en: So, yeah, just, I suppose, for me, being a bit organized,
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，对我和我而言，就是保持一定程度的条理，

sentences.en: thinking ahead of time about stuff that I know is good for me and then trying to stick to it or getting other people to remind me for it.
sentences.zh: 提前思考那些我知道对自己有益的事情，然后努力坚持下去，或者让其他人来提醒我。

sentences.en: You know, I think I have to say that one of my trainees that was back in Salford, you know, before I went out, I was like,
sentences.zh: 你知道，我想我必须说，我在索尔福德的一个培训生，你知道，在我出发前，我对她说：

sentences.en: check in on me because I might be a bit more irritable than normal.
sentences.zh: “随时关注我，因为我可能会比平时更易怒。”

sentences.en: I might be a bit tired.
sentences.zh: “我可能会有点累。”

sentences.en: And she was great at just sort of asking that question, because, again, when you're in a perceived position of power, people don't necessarily ask.
sentences.zh: 而她非常擅长顺势问出这个问题，因为同样地，当你处于一个人们眼中掌握权力的位置时，别人不一定会主动问起。

sentences.en: But it was really good just to have someone that within a safe space, almost like a peer supervision element, just to try and make sure that, you know,
sentences.zh: 但能有一个人在一个安全空间里，有点像同伴督导的性质，来确保你知道，

sentences.en: I'm not going down a path or that I'm not thinking too much, I'd say.
sentences.zh: 我没有误入歧途，或者我没有想得太多，这就真的是太好了。

sentences.en: So, yeah, so, yeah, there was a few things that, you know, we teach others to do and I wanted to practice what we preach.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，所以，是的，有一些事情是我们教导别人去做的，而我也想言行一致地去践行。

sentences.en: I haven't done anything specific in terms of supervision or seeking, I suppose, counselling support, because I don't think it's,
sentences.zh: 在督导或寻求咨询支持方面，我没有做任何特别的事情，因为我认为这不属于，

sentences.en: I've been one step separate from that and it was short term basis.
sentences.zh: 我与那保持了一步之遥，而且那是短期的。

sentences.en: But, you know, if that comes up in the future, that's not something I would shy away from for sure.
sentences.zh: 但是，如果以后出现这种情况，这绝对不是我会回避的事情。

sentences.en: Oh, I mean, you said the words right out of my mouth, but you really have been practicing what we preach.
sentences.zh: 哦，我的意思是，你简直说出了我的心声，但你确实一直在身体力行我们所倡导的理念。

sentences.en: You know, the basics of eating, sleeping, activity scheduling, you know, trying to look for the things that, you know,
sentences.zh: 你知道，饮食、睡眠、活动安排这些基础的事情，你知道，试着寻找那些，你知道的，

sentences.en: keep you well generally and trying to see what you can do to keep those as constant as possible.
sentences.zh: 能让你保持整体健康的事情，并努力看看能做些甚么来尽可能地让这些保持稳定。

sentences.en: But it made me think about some of my conversations with the people that were staying with my mum and they were like, there's too many vegetables here in this country.
sentences.zh: 但这让我想起了一些我和住在母亲家的人的交谈，他们说：这里的蔬菜太多了。

sentences.en: We need more meat.
sentences.zh: 我们需要更多的肉。

sentences.en: And so I can see how, if that's kind of what you were around, that you might have put on more weight than you're used to as well.
sentences.zh: 所以我能理解，如果你身处那种环境，你体重增加的幅度可能也会超过你的习惯。

sentences.en: Oh yeah, very much so.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的，确实如此。

sentences.en: It's a lot harder to lose when you're a bit older as well.
sentences.zh: 而且年龄稍大一点后，减肥也难得多。

sentences.en: Oh yeah, I hear you, I hear you.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的，我懂，我懂。

sentences.en: But, you know, I was, it's only the second time I've met you.
sentences.zh: 不过，你知道，这是我第二次见你。

sentences.en: I follow you on Twitter and was trying to follow your exploits on there a little bit.
sentences.zh: 我在Twitter上关注了你，并试着在那里稍微追踪一下你的英勇事迹。

sentences.en: Are we allowed to say Twitter anymore?
sentences.zh: 我们现在还能说Twitter这个词吗？

sentences.en: I don't think we are.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我们不能了。

sentences.en: You know, X, whatever it is.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，X，随便叫什么吧。

sentences.en: But, you know, like your parents, I was worried about you.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，就像你的父母一样，我很为你担心。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Sadly, when you were there, there were two British journalists, it turned out, who were missing and did not survive.
sentences.zh: 可悲的是，当你身在那里的时候，结果发现有两名英国记者失踪了，且未能幸免。

sentences.en: But to begin with, that was reported as two British men.
sentences.zh: 但一开始，这被报道为两名英国男子。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 对的，对的。

sentences.en: And, you know, everybody who knows you and everybody who knows them, of course, would have been thinking, oh gosh, oh gosh.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，每一个认识你的人，每一个认识他们的人，当然都会想：天哪，天哪。

sentences.en: You know, and it's very difficult.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这非常艰难。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It wasn't easy for you either.
sentences.zh: 你也不容易。

sentences.en: It's tricky because I'm also, I also wasn't allowed to say where I was.
sentences.zh: 这挺微妙的，因为我也……我当时也不能说我在哪里。

sentences.en: And there were people who didn't know, but I don't, I think, I think from my side, I was able to tell broadly people back home where I was and I was sort of northwestern Ukraine,
sentences.zh: 而且有些人不知道，不过我——我想，从我这边来说，我大概能告诉家乡的人我在哪里，我差不多在乌克兰西北部，

sentences.en: which is very reassuring when you think how far away it is from things.
sentences.zh: 考虑到这地方离其他地方有多远，这让人感到挺安心的。

sentences.en: But the, yeah, like I say, people who slightly more removed or I might be able to, who weren't got a message from me just in general, were wondering what was going on.
sentences.zh: 但，是的，就像我说的，那些稍微离得远一点的人，或者我可能联系不上、没能经常收到我消息的人，就会纳闷到底发生了什么。

sentences.en: And interestingly, a lot of my friends who I worked with out there from the WHO have still been working out there.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，我在那儿一起工作的很多世卫组织朋友，至今仍在那儿工作。

sentences.en: And it's been harder for me back here seeing what's going on out there and then going, oh gosh, is that, is that near you?
sentences.zh: 对回到这里的我来说，看着那边发生的事情，然后心里想：哦天哪，那是——那是离你很近吗？这就变得更难了。

sentences.en: Or there is something near them and worrying about them more now I'm back than I was about myself when I was out there.
sentences.zh: 或者是有什么事发生在他们附近，比起我在那边时担心自己，我现在回来后反而更担心他们。

sentences.en: I felt far safer when I was out there than people might, might thought I would have been.
sentences.zh: 我在那边时感到的安全感，其实比大家想象的要高得多。

sentences.en: So, yeah, that was, that was odd.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，这挺——这挺奇怪的。

sentences.en: But yeah, I think, I mean, it was always,
sentences.zh: 不过是的，我想，我的意思是，这总是……

sentences.en: it was funny telling my mum and my dad about it because my mum worked for the NHS for 40 or 50 years as a nurse and she did a bit of work in Hong Kong over that time.
sentences.zh: 把这事告诉我的爸爸妈妈挺有意思的，因为我妈妈在英国国家医疗服务体系（NHS）当了四十年或五十年的护士，期间还在香港工作过一段时间。

sentences.en: And so she was used, she, she was sort of used to the idea of doing a bit of work away.
sentences.zh: 所以她习惯了——她差不多习惯了去外地做点工作的这种想法。

sentences.en: But I think I told her, you know, oh, you know, I've got a job, it's really exciting.
sentences.zh: 但我想我告诉她的时候，你知道的，哦，你知道的，我找到了一份工作，真的很让人兴奋。

sentences.en: I'm going to be working for the WHO.
sentences.zh: 我要去世卫组织工作了。

sentences.en: She's like, oh, that's amazing.
sentences.zh: 她就说，哦，太棒了。

sentences.en: That's fantastic.
sentences.zh: 这太了不起了。

sentences.en: And then she goes, where?
sentences.zh: 然后她问，在哪里？

sentences.en: And I was like, oh, in Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 我说，哦，在乌克兰。

sentences.en: And then I took a screenshot of it at the time because I was, but she, it was crestfallen.
sentences.zh: 当时我顺手截了个图，因为我——但她当时一脸沮丧。

sentences.en: But at the same time, there's so much pride in it.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，这也是一种莫大的骄傲。

sentences.en: And I think, I think that was the heartening thing.
sentences.zh: 我想，我觉得这才是最让人振奋的地方。

sentences.en: I didn't want to make people too worried or too upset.
sentences.zh: 我不想让大家太担心或太难过。

sentences.en: But at the same time, it's a very just thing to be doing.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，这是一件非常正义的事情。

sentences.en: And I think if I thought it was too dangerous, I would have just probably pulled out or tried to end the contract early.
sentences.zh: 我想如果我觉得太危险，我可能就会直接退出，或者试着提前结束合同了。

sentences.en: So, yeah, it's difficult, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，这很难，对吧？

sentences.en: We have it in the UK if there's a major incident in London.
sentences.zh: 我们在英国也遇到过，比如伦敦发生重大事故的时候。

sentences.en: I've had that with friends in 2007, mates working in London and the bus bombing.
sentences.zh: 2007年我朋友在伦敦工作时赶上公交车爆炸案，我就经历过这种事。

sentences.en: And I was like, oh, gosh, and there's the whole check-in thing and that sort of stuff.
sentences.zh: 当时我就想：哦，天哪。然后还有那种全体报平安之类的事情。

sentences.en: So, yeah, I've seen it from the other side.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我从另一个角度见识过。

sentences.en: I think, I think that's the thing, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 我想，我想就是这么回事，对吧？

sentences.en: I was struck by that today.
sentences.zh: 我今天深有感触。

sentences.en: So, just before we met, I popped to Aldi to get some bits and pieces and bought myself a new pair of slippers, which I'm very excited about.
sentences.zh: 就在我们见面之前，我顺便去阿尔迪超市买零碎的东西，还给自己买了一双新拖鞋，我对此兴奋得不行。

sentences.en: This is the thing, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 这就是生活，对吧？

sentences.en: People are just going about their normal lives.
sentences.zh: 人们都在过着平常的生活。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And, you know, even in Israel, this time last week, people were just out there buying slippers and dishwasher tablets, you know?
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，甚至在以色列，就在上周这个时候，人们也只是在那儿买拖鞋和洗碗块，对吧？

sentences.en: And it's when it just catches you in the middle of your ordinary life.
sentences.zh: 而当它恰好在你过着平凡生活的时候袭击了你，

sentences.en: It's really derailing.
sentences.zh: 真的会让人心态崩溃。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I think, I suppose to reflect on what it looked like out there as well, there is a new normal for the guys in Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 我想，如果要回想一下那里的情况，乌克兰的小伙子们已经适应了一种新常态。

sentences.en: There's a curfew still at 11 p.m.
sentences.zh: 全国各地依然实行晚上11点宵禁，

sentences.en: for everyone across the country.
sentences.zh: 所有人都要遵守。

sentences.en: There's air raids and people are supposed to go to air raid shelters, but depending on where you are,
sentences.zh: 有空袭警报，人们本该去防空洞，但具体取决于你在哪里，

sentences.en: you're more or less likely to do that because there's an app that tells you there's an air raid.
sentences.zh: 你去的可能性或大或小，因为有一个应用会告诉你发生了空袭。

sentences.en: There's also people messaging saying, oh, no, it's not here.
sentences.zh: 还会有人发消息说：哦，没有啦，不在这里，已经从这里过去了，诸如此类。

sentences.en: It's gone past here, et cetera.
sentences.zh: 每个人都有充电宝，因为手机和电力可能会中断。

sentences.en: Everyone's got power banks because phones and electricity can go down.
sentences.zh: 同样地，你走在商业街上，每家店外面都放着一台汽油发电机，以防断电。

sentences.en: Similarly, you walk down the high street, every shop's got a sort of a petrol generator outside when the power cuts happen.
sentences.zh: 而且交通基础设施也受到了影响，因为他们必须把资金投入到军事上。

sentences.en: And the transport infrastructure has been affected because they've had to invest in the military.
sentences.zh: 所以出行困难多了。

sentences.en: So getting around is a lot harder.
sentences.zh: 道路破损得也厉害得多。

sentences.en: The roads are a lot more cut up.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道的，乌克兰民众对赢得胜利有着坚定的信念，并且坚信他们在做正确的事。

sentences.en: But, you know, there's a big belief amongst the Ukrainian population about winning and also that this is the right thing to do.
sentences.zh: 我想这也是一些从邻国加入救援的人们的写照，因为他们担心自己会是下一个。

sentences.en: And I think that's reflected in some of the people who've joined the effort from neighbouring countries because they're worried about being next.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个非常非常有趣的情况，因为他们某种程度上已经适应了，但这一切依然是不对的。

sentences.en: So it's a really, really interesting one because they have, I suppose, have adjusted to it, but it's still not right.
sentences.zh: 其中一桩很能说明问题的事是，我们的一个司机说起过，如果在上学期间发生空袭，学校就会关门。

sentences.en: One of the things that was really telling was one of our drivers was talking about, you know, if an air raid happens during school hours, the school shuts.
sentences.zh: 所以家长必须去把孩子们接走，让他们离开学校。

sentences.en: So parents have to go get the kids, pull them out of school.
sentences.zh: 我就想，这是否将引发一代人的创伤？或者人们长期无法获得充足的教育，会对整整一代人产生什么影响？

sentences.en: And I'm like, well, there's a generational trauma about to happen or what are the generational effects of people not getting adequate access to education over time?
sentences.zh: 这会如何影响人们日后就业？

sentences.en: What does it affect people going into employment?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，很多适龄工作男性都在军队服役。

sentences.en: You know, lots of working age men are in the military.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，有太多的动态因素让人们勉强接受了一种新常态，但这一切却看不到尽头。

sentences.en: So, yeah, there's just a lot of dynamics where people have sort of accepted a new norm, but there's no end point in science.
sentences.zh: 说真的，这日子该怎么继续下去？

sentences.en: How do you carry on that on, really?
sentences.zh: 是的，非常重要的问题，非常重要的问题。

sentences.en: Yeah, really important questions, really important questions.
sentences.zh: 我想我们毕竟是人类，我们会适应的，对吧？

sentences.en: And I guess we're humans and we adapt, don't we?
sentences.zh: 因为还能有什么别的选择呢，你知道的？

sentences.en: Because what are the other choices, you know?
sentences.zh: 不，这真的是个太大的问题了，对吧？

sentences.en: No, it's just such a huge question, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 要知道，我们国家并没有经历过战时状态。

sentences.en: You know, we've not experienced wartime in our country.
sentences.zh: 你知道，往上数几代人可能有过，但当你亲眼目睹，甚至是通过第二手消息看到时，感觉是完全不同的，你知道的。

sentences.en: You know, there's a few generations back you have, but it's very different when you see it first hand or even second hand, you know.
sentences.zh: 我以前根本没想过会有空袭应用这东西。

sentences.en: And I just had not imagined there'd be an air raid app.
sentences.zh: 你知道，什么都有对应的应用，但它们确实挺有用的。

sentences.en: You know, there are apps for everything, but they are pretty useful.
sentences.zh: 如果你需要的话，这算是个相当实用的应用。

sentences.en: It's a pretty useful app to have if you need it.
sentences.zh: 这太不可思议了。

sentences.en: It's incredible.
sentences.zh: 是的，同样地，我以前没想到会是这样，不过我想，你知道的，我有些朋友去过日本，他们会收到龙卷风预警。

sentences.en: Yeah, again, I didn't think that would be the case, but I think, you know, I've had friends who'd been out in Japan and they'd get warnings about tornadoes.
sentences.zh: 当时我就想：哦，对哦，这很合理。

sentences.en: And I was like, oh, yeah, that makes sense.
sentences.zh: 然后直到我到了乌克兰，

sentences.en: And then it was when I got to Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 哦，对了，你需要下载这个。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah, you need to download this.
sentences.zh: 它会告诉你空袭什么时候开始，什么时候结束。

sentences.en: This will tell you when the air raid starts and when it stops.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，我们住的地方，

sentences.en: And, you know, where we were staying as well.
sentences.zh: 他们有一个防空警报器。

sentences.en: They had a siren.
sentences.zh: 那声音就是你在伦敦轰炸时期的电影里听到的那种。

sentences.en: And it is what you hear in the films from the Blitz.
sentences.zh: 一模一样。

sentences.en: It's exactly that.
sentences.zh: 就感觉自己像是被时光倒流带回了过去。

sentences.en: And it's like you feel like you're transported back in time.

sentences.en: You know, when I hear something on TV, I was like, oh, sort of transported back.
sentences.zh: 不是那种身临其境的重历感，而仅仅是勾起回忆，你知道的。

sentences.en: Not in a reliving sense, but it's just reminiscent, you know.
sentences.zh: 所以声音很大。

sentences.en: So it's loud.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道的，我不知道你有没有去上过颂钵音疗课，某些频率会在你的身体里产生共鸣。

sentences.zh: 现在回想起来，好像没有，我通常都戴着耳塞。

sentences.zh: 不过，是的，我觉得我本身倒没有那种感觉。

sentences.en: But, yeah, I don't think I had that per se.
sentences.zh: 但我想我大概在某种程度上已经适应了它。

sentences.en: But, you know, if people are moved or intrigued about what we're talking about, is there a best place they can learn?

sentences.en: Oh, gosh, I don't know, really.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这挺棘手的，因为我想，在战争刚爆发时，大家曾经有一大波儿行动，纷纷提供支持并往那边运送物资。

sentences.en: I think it's tricky because I think there was a big, I suppose, a big move early on in the war about people offering support and sending things out there.

sentences.zh: 但除此之外，我想对我而言，我正试图分享在那边做出的好工作，并让大家看到心理健康正被提上日程。

sentences.en: But aside from that, I suppose for me, I'm trying to share the good work that's being done out there and share it as a mental health is on the agenda.

sentences.en: And the WHO and the Ministry of Health out there are pushing this.

sentences.en: But it's difficult to, I suppose it's difficult to get that momentum or sometimes to know what to do.
sentences.zh: 我只发挥了非常微小的一部分作用，不过我想眼下我只是在尽力支持我认识的那些伙伴，让他们能够去帮助更多的人。

sentences.en: And I've got, I've had a very small part to play, but I suppose I'm just trying to, at the moment, support the guys I know in being able to support more people.
sentences.zh: 所以这几乎就像是一种乘数效应，你知道的。

sentences.en: So almost like multiplier effect, you know.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，玛丽安，我真的不太确定。

sentences.en: So, yeah, I'm not sure really, Marianne.
sentences.zh: 我很抱歉。

sentences.en: I'm sorry.
sentences.zh: 好的，没关系。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，你觉得自己只起到了很小的一部分作用，但对我来说，

sentences.en: Okay, that's all right.
sentences.zh: 我知道你倾注在那里的善意、良好的实操经验，以及如何以富有同情心、整体化的方式建立服务的坚实原则，将会产生深远的影响。

sentences.en: And, you know, you feel like it's a small part, but I guess for me,
sentences.zh: 不仅是现在，而且在未来的岁岁年年里。

sentences.en: I know that the goodness that you're putting in there and the good practice and the really sound principles of how to set up a service in a compassionate,
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，你知道的，我为你作为一个人感到由衷的骄傲，

sentences.en: holistic way are going to be far reaching.
sentences.zh: 同时也为你的专业能够做到这一点感到自豪，你能够在那个国家如此关键的时刻提供这种帮助。

sentences.en: Not just now, but in years and years to come.

sentences.en: So I think, you know, I feel really proud of you as a human,

sentences.en: but also really proud of the profession that you've been able to do that and you've been able to offer that at such an important time for that country.
sentences.zh: 不，你知道的，谢谢你。

sentences.en: So, you know, not my place to be proud of you, but I am all the same.
sentences.zh: 你能这么说真是太好了、太客气了。

sentences.en: And thank you for doing this really important work and to share your skills so richly and freely, you know, at risk to yourself.
sentences.zh: 听到别人为你感到骄傲，高兴你做了自己做过的事，这种感觉总是很好的，对吧？

sentences.zh: 我并不认为我做这些是为了听到这些评价。

sentences.en: It's very, very nice of you to say.
sentences.zh: 这是我觉得自己能够做到的一件事。

sentences.en: I think it's always nice to hear, isn't it, that people are proud of you and glad that you've done what you've done.
sentences.zh: 它在我的最近发展区之内。

sentences.en: I don't think I'd say that's what I did it for.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上也在我的能力范围内，尽管可能稍微有点挑战性。

sentences.en: It's something I thought I can do.
sentences.zh: 但话说回来，我想当我离开乌克兰、结束在那里的工作时，你能真切感受到那种如潮般的感激之情。

sentences.en: It's within my zone of proximal development.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，当你走在街上时，人们通常会问：你为什么会在这里？

sentences.en: It's within my wheelhouse to a degree, but perhaps a bit of a stretch.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But yeah, I think when I was leaving Ukraine and when I was finishing out there, you got a sense of the outpouring of the gratitude.
sentences.zh: 然后当他们弄清楚之后，同样会流露出一种惊讶，

sentences.en: And, you know, when you walk down the streets, people are generally like, why are you here?
sentences.zh: 随之而来的则是对你居然愿意置身于这种境地所迸发出的浓浓爱意和感激之情。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 一开始我对这事可能有点漫不经心，现在大概也还有点这意思。

sentences.en: And then when they find out, there's similar sort of a bit of amazement,
sentences.zh: 不过是的，我想随着时间的推移，我大概会开始意识到它的严重性。

sentences.en: but also then a real outpouring of love and affection for the fact that you're actually wanting to put yourself in that situation.

sentences.en: And I was probably a bit blasé about it at the start and probably still a bit now.
sentences.zh: 从一开始她几乎是在边学边旁听我做的事，到现在她能为其他人进行授课或持续专业发展（CPD）培训，这真的很棒。

sentences.en: But yeah, I think over time, I'll probably think about the gravity of it.
sentences.zh: 就像我说的，希望这只是一个薄薄的地基，他们可以在此基础上继续建设，并为其他人提供帮助。

sentences.en: And I think seeing the psychologist, particularly sort of like Nadia, who's one of the ones I've been mentoring and seeing how she's come on since I first went out there.
sentences.zh: 因为在此之前，这可能并不是一个特别受欢迎的职业，类似于职业治疗（OT），相对较新，或者资源不足、缺乏体系。

sentences.en: And she was almost learning and sitting in the stuff I was doing to now when she's delivering teaching or CPD for others is great.
sentences.zh: 所以希望——不幸的是这件事把问题推到了风口浪尖，但希望公众对心理学的看法能因此有所改变，从而带来一些好的结果。

sentences.en: And like I said, hopefully there's just a thin foundation that they can then build on and provide to others.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Because previously it's probably been, it's not been a particularly popular profession, similar to OT, relatively new or sort of undersourced or lack of structure.
sentences.zh: 你让我想起了我过去和服役人员、以及和在警察局和消防局工作的人共事的经历。

sentences.en: So hopefully, unfortunately, this has brought it to the surface, but hopefully there is some good coming out of it in terms of the public perception of psychology being changed.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，能够迎着人们通常会逃离的方向奔跑的人，往往是某种特定类型的人。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 你会觉得自己总体上是那种追求心跳加速、肾上腺素飙升的人吗？

sentences.en: And you're making me think about when I've worked with service personnel and when I've worked with people that work in the police and in the fire service.
sentences.zh: 还是说这是头一遭？

sentences.zh: 我本来想说不是的，但接着我可能会——然后你大概就会问我后续的问题，比如：哦对，我做过这个，我做过那个，我还做过那个。

sentences.en: Would you say you're kind of a white knuckle sort of adrenaline sort of guy generally?
sentences.zh: 所以我想我确实会做这类事情，但我并不是那种——我不一定是追求肾上腺素的狂热分子，但我确实、我一直都在进行竞技体育。

sentences.en: Or is this new?
sentences.zh: 为了放松，我做的事情一直都是相当充满活力的。

sentences.en: I was going to say no, but then I'll probably, then you'll probably ask me a follow-up question about, oh yeah, I've done that and I've done that and I've done that.

sentences.en: So I think I do, I do those sort of things, but I'm not sort of a, I'm not necessarily an adrenaline junkie, but I do, I've always been competitive sports.
sentences.zh: 我想其中有很多人都渴望直接重返战场，或者因为无法回去而感到内疚。

sentences.en: I've done things that I think to relax, I've always done something quite active.
sentences.zh: 我以前认为能让我放松的事情，一直都是一些相当充满活力的事情。

sentences.en: But yeah, I think, I think, again, just going back to what you're saying about sort of people running towards it, a lot of the guys we saw out there were military, obviously.
sentences.zh: 不过是的，我觉得，我觉得，还是回到你刚才说的关于人们迎难而上的话题，我们在那里看到很多人显然都是军人。

sentences.en: And I suppose there's, there was a lot of them who wanted to get straight back into it or felt guilty about not being able to go back.

sentences.en: So yeah, I, I, I like doing things that are energising, but yeah, it's, I wouldn't say I run towards it quite so much.

sentences.en: No, okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧，行。
